quest.title: Problem-Sorting Robot
quest.description: In the Krumkake Craftshop, Aino is currently having trouble with a malfunctioning robot...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

talks.objective: Return to the Krumkake Craftshop at a later date to have a look
Return to the Krumkake Craftshop to have a look

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Nothing's going right lately! Is a good night's sleep too much to ask for!?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: There there, Aino. If nothing is going right, then "nothing" is the problem. And if nothing is the problem, everything is going to be alright.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #You really think so? You know, Ineffa, you've gotten a lot better at comforting people since you went away. I bet it's {NICKNAME}'s influence.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I could not say. But, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Please get some rest. I will inspect these sorting robots for you.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Uh-uh! I'm gonna give each one a hit on the head with my wrench. I gotta see for myself which one is going haywire.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}! Paimon! It's you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi, Aino! Hi, Ineffa!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It feels like it's been aaaages since I last saw you two. Or, wait... maybe not. I dunno, it's all a blur. Sorry, I didn't sleep too good last night. My head's a mess.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: But, anyway, seeing you makes me feel a bit better.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino, it appears my analysis was correct.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh...?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #You were getting upset over "nothing," but now that {NICKNAME} and Paimon are here, your mood has improved.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Conclusion: Everything is going to be alright.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh, well I can't fault that logic...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, what's the matter, Aino? You can tell us. Whatever's going on, we'll help you out!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, it's nothing major. People keep getting into fights around here, and last night they crashed right into my workshop! All the clinking and clanking makes it hard to sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop is living up to its name... Ah, sorry. Not the point... So who are these people? They sound dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Do not be alarmed. It's a group of Treasure Hoarders on the run after stealing from the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Treasure Hoarders? Dipping into the Fatui's pockets? Wow, the Nod-Krai faction's pretty bold.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry! Again, not the point... What matters is, disturbing people in the middle of the night is unacceptable!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yeah, before Ineffa came back, all I could do was hide in the workshop and curse them under my breath. But, now... Hehe! I can teach them a lesson!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I already cleared them out last night. You will not be bothered again, Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're the best, Ineffa.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! So... Problem solved, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Well, the sleeping problem is solved. But, now there's an issue with my prospector bots. They're supposed to sort out the useful treasure from the junk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice! Sounds impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: No, not impressive! There's a traitor among them!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Correct. The sorting bots delivered several items of no utility this morning. The ratio of useful to non-useful items suggests that one of the bots has malfunctioned.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: My bots don't just break down for no reason. You know what I think? It was sabotage! And it must've been one of those people from last night!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then we'll find 'em, and make 'em pay!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yeah! But, first, I need to figure out which bot they messed with.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are you going to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: By staring 'em down! You gotta put a little pressure on 'em, and see which one starts to sweat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so psychological warfare...? That works on robots?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I dunno. If it doesn't work, I'll just drag them into a small room and interrogate them one by one, hehehe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can't you just take them apart and see which one's broken?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Whoa, how's that fair? Two of them are just hardworking little bots. If I take them apart even though nothing's wrong, it'll hurt their feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Okay, then... Ahem, alright, listen up, you three! One of you has messed up big time, and if you don't own up, you'll be dragging your friends down with you. So, time to come clean! Or we'll... or we'll....

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, what are we gonna do, again?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: We'll let you off, but just this once!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Stare down the bots to track down the culprit)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You stared them down alright, {NICKNAME}! Notice anything off?

choices.text: It's the bot on the left.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, it's clearly the one on the right!

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Yep, that's it! What did I say? A little psychological pressure does the trick!

choices.text: It's the bot in the center.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, it's clearly the one on the right!

choices.text: It's the bot on the right.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: C'mon, help me catch him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino, Ineffa, we caught him! Do you need to check him over?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Analyzing exterior... No anomalies detected. The probability of malfunction due to an external injury is low.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Huh, must be the processor, then... Let me open him up and have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh! He's on the run again!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Catch him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Is that him? How did he get so big?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: No, those are scrapped sorting bots. It appears he can still connect to them.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay, well now I'm getting curious. There's more going on here than a simple malfunction...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: But, we need to catch him first!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #Why don't you take the reins, {NICKNAME}? It's super cool! You'll see!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally, we caught him. Man, what is going on with this bot!?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: Hmph, wouldn't you like to know!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? You... You can talk!? Aino, is he supposed to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: No, it's not possible... I mean, my prospector bots do have a voice function, but it's all pre-set phrases...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: There's no way they have awareness like Ineffa. Their cores aren't even a fraction as advanced as hers...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, it seems like he can communicate. Could his core have been... upgraded or something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you tell me your name?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: Can you mind your own business?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Geez, why is this bot so aggressive! It's like we're the ones being interrogated!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: Oh, just you wait! If you don't get out of my sight, I'll round you all up and send you straight to the Fortress of Meroseed!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The Fortress of Meroseed? What kind of place is that?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: It's, it's... It's... Huh? What is it again...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean, the Fortress of Meropide?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: Meropide... Yeah... yeah that, that seems right...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you're from Fontaine?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: Would you stop with the personal questions? So intrusive! Leave a girl alone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what do you mean, "girl"? You're a junk sorting robot!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: I'm a girl!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay, well I'm not sure what happened, but something is definitely wrong here... This isn't the prospector bot I know, that's for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Well, guess the only way to find out is to open you up and see what's going on!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: Don't come any closer! Somebody help!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's okay. I'm a girl, too!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: That doesn't change anything!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #Apologies, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Aino prefers to devote her full focus to solving problems. I believe she needs some time to get to the bottom of this issue.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Perhaps it would be best to follow up tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Weird... I know I only installed an average Nod-Krai machine core...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino! Ineffa! We're here!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well? Is the problem solved?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I mean, I found the source of the malfunction. But now I have way more questions than answers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Why?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The bot has the wrong core. It is not the one Aino installed originally, but the core of a clockwork meka from Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It has the wrong core!? So now we have to hunt down the original one!?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Eh, it's no big deal. The original core was just something I salvaged from a pile of junk. Believe me, it's nothing special.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: The problem is, this new core is really advanced. I don't even understand half of its functions...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Is that why it can talk like Ineffa?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: No idea. What I can tell is that this core went through a massive explosion at some point. Almost all the modules are damaged, but I can't fix any of them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... If even Aino's stumped, it must be really complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: The core originates from Fontaine, but little is known about this technology. Without relevant knowledge, a breakthrough will take time.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yeah, but it's not all bad news! Hehe, I managed to extract a useful bit of information from the data I could salvage. One word: Chard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chard? Is that its name?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I doubt it, but I'm sure it's important! It was stored in the deepest part of the core. That's the best-protected part, which is why I was able to salvage something from there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The best-protected part...?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: In the event that my core sustained damage, that's where I would move all Aino-related data to keep it intact.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: AH! Knock on wood, knock on wood! Your core is gonna be just fine, Ineffa! Don't jinx yourself like that!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I was engaging in a hypothetical discussion.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Doesn't matter! You still gotta say it! Say "knock on wood"!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...Knock on wood... Like that?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yeah. Whew, that was a close one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh...?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Anyway, I bet there's other data preserved deep in the core, too. Otherwise, this thing wouldn't be able to talk.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And I'm gonna extract it all! Hehe, here data, come to Aino~

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Man, this core is so mysterious... But, if it's so hi-tech, how did it end up inside a random prospector bot?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Bingo! That's the question, isn't it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Who replaced the original core with this one, and why? I mean, even though it's damaged, the research value is off the charts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe it has something to do with the Fatui or the Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Bingo! That has to be the answer!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: You know what happened the day before it started malfunctioning? The Fatui chased a group of Treasure Hoarders straight into my workshop.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I'm thinking, the Treasure Hoarders stole the core from the Fatui and needed a place to hide it. So, they stuffed it in my prospector bot, and handed the original core over to the Fatui to smooth things over.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Makes sense, don't you think? I'm pretty clever, right Ineffa?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Of course. In fact, intel from the Curatorium appears to corroborate this hypothesis.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Several of Marionette's subordinates were robbed on their way back to Snezhnaya. Although it is unclear what was stolen, the culprits were identified as a group of three Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Their leader is a silver-haired woman wearing a hood. As for the remaining two members, there is a man with pink hair and a man with purple hair.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, so Paimon was right! The local Treasure Hoarders around here are bold!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Actually, this group has only been active recently. The Curatorium suspects them to be outsiders not local to this area.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Eh, who cares. Jahoda said they're just a bunch of small fry, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, what should we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, if those Treasure Hoarders really did mean to hide the core in this bot, they're probably gonna come back for it.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Let them come. If they're nice, I'll even share my krumkakes with them.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And if they're mean, Ineffa will give them a good, old knuckle sandwich!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And, if they try to take back the core?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe, already thought of that! I'm just gonna hide it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ineffa, can you get Little Chard and the others to come over here?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay, hold onto your hats! I'm gonna hide Little Chard... in a scrapped prospector bot!

dialogues.speaker: Little Chard
dialogues.text: What did you just call me?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: C'mon, we have to call you something. What, do you already have a name?

dialogues.speaker: Little Chard
dialogues.text: L...Lombro?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: What kind of name is that? Did you get it from somewhere in your data bank? It doesn't sound like a little girl's name to me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about... Chard Lombro?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ohhh, so use "Lombro" as a last name. Huh, I kinda like it! Then, it's decided: You're Chard Lombro from now on! No complaining, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: You're stuck with it either way. You were the one who decided to hide out here, so from now on, you work for me!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't think it likes the sound of that...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Correction: This bot has no capacity to like or dislike something in its current state.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Because its core was destroyed six ways to Sunday! So, right now, its tone and mannerisms are all just a simulation of whatever data has been preserved.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Like, remember how I found the word "Chard" in the data? Well, if that refers to a person, then basically, Little Chard is just imitating their way of speaking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's how it works...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Anyway, we can figure all that out later. First, we need to make sure Little Chard is hidden.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #Why don't you take the reins, {NICKNAME}? It's super cool! You'll see!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Nice job! You've got some engineering chops, that's for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: And, thanks to you, I'm now the proud owner of the most advanced prospector bot in town!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I expect good work out of you, Little Chard. But, don't worry. You'll be compensated.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Like I care!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmm, we gotta do something about that temper of yours... Maybe a little flower on your head will soften you up a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: There. Much cuter!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #Oh, that reminds me! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, if you ever pick up stuff you have no use for, like screws and nuts and things, just bring 'em to me!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I can make them into flowers or use them to upgrade my console. Oh, and I don't expect you to hand them over for free! I pay good prices for scrap! You're gonna wanna stop by every day!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Deal?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Deal.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Awesome! Turns out Ineffa was right all along. Everything IS gonna be alright!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Good luck out there on your travels. I hope everything goes alright for you too.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Alright, here I go!

dialogues.speaker: Strange Prospector Bot
dialogues.text: AAAHHH!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Don't be scared. She's not gonna hurt you.
